description: This file implements a high-quality audio stream resampler using the SoX ResamplerStream library. It is designed for real-time processing, handling long audio streams, and reusing resampler configurations to optimize performance. The class SOXRStreamAudioResampler extends a base resampler class and provides methods for initialization, state management, and resampling audio data chunks.

classes.name: SOXRStreamAudioResampler
classes.description: Implements an audio resampler using the SoX ResampleStream library, supporting high-quality sample rate conversion, typically for real-time audio stream processing. It maintains internal state for seamless chunk-wise resampling and supports only mono 16-bit PCM audio.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the resampler object, setting internal state variables to None or default values.

methods.name: _initialize(self, in_rate: float, out_rate: float)
methods.description: Creates a new SoX ResampleStream object with specified input and output sample rates, recording the time of initialization.

methods.name: _maybe_clear_internal_state(self)
methods.description: Clears the internal resampling stream if a specified period has passed without resampling, to avoid artifacts.

methods.name: _maybe_initialize_sox_stream(self, in_rate: int, out_rate: int)
methods.description: Ensures the internal resampling stream is created or reset if sample rates change, raising an error if incompatible.

methods.name: bytes resample(self, audio: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int)
methods.description: Performs resampling of input audio bytes from the original sample rate to the target sample rate, returning the resampled audio as bytes. Uses the SoX ResampleStream library.
